note.overview: The job of any marketplace is to facilitate the matching of supply with demand in real time. Success is often measured using various metrics. The challenge is to design matching algorithms to balance the tradeoffs among multiple objectives in a stochastic environment, to arrive at a “compromise” solution, which minimizes say the [Formula: see text]-norm–based distance function between the attained performance metrics and the target performances.
